d.title: Shaman King: Flowers
d.synopsis: Following the story of Hana Asakura, the son of Yoh and Anna Asakura. The series follows the lives of the next generation of the original cast of Shaman King. Set after the Shaman Fight tournament's conclusion in the original series, Hana gets forced into competing in another new Shaman Fight competition titled the Flowers of Maize.
